trigger: Night, on the way to the trench. An alley off Fourth Street. (Close glimpse, non-combat.)

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: An alley behind the old bowling stadium. Rain turning to sleet. Wraith stops so hard her collar chokes.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: At the far end of the alley, under a dead sodium light: something tall. Standing. Watching you.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It's thin the way a shadow is thin. Its eyes catch your flashlight and give it back flat and silver.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [She doesn't growl. She presses against your legs and shakes.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: It turns, unhurried, and walks out of the light on all fours.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: [Behind you, very quietly] You saw that. Tell me you saw that.

nodes.speaker: ruiz
nodes.text: Third one this month. Patrol logs say 'animal.' Patrols that see them stop writing logs.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You stand there until the rain soaks through. Then you go to the trench, because there's nothing else to do.
